dataBody: We are the operator of the service, not a party to your deals — we keep the facts you and your counterparty record, we don’t decide who’s right.
dataFullText: We store what you and your counterparty record about a deal — timestamps, document hashes, checklist acceptances and signatures. We don't hold your money and we don't decide who's right in a disagreement; that's for you, your counterparty, or — if it comes to it — the venue your contract names. Personal data is processed to run the service (accounts, contracts, evidence) and is never sold. You can request a copy or deletion at any time; deleting your account removes your personal data, though facts already shared with a counterparty in a signed deal stay as their evidence too.
